_comment: Single source for company details, links, pricing and feature flags. Every value marked PLACEHOLDER must be replaced before launch.

brand.name: Selo
brand.tagline: WhatsApp that sells, answers and reports, built for Shopify.
brand.description: Selo connects your Shopify store to WhatsApp: automated order updates, campaigns that drive sales, an AI assistant that answers from your real store data, and a copilot you can text.

company._schedulingUrl: PLACEHOLDER: Calendly or Cal.com link. Empty = link to the demo form instead.

forms._endpoint: PLACEHOLDER: form handler URL. Overridden by the FORM_ENDPOINT environment variable. Empty = demo mode (shows the success message, sends nothing).
forms._turnstileSiteKey: PLACEHOLDER: Cloudflare Turnstile site key. Empty = honeypot only.

analytics._comment: Loaded only after the visitor accepts analytics cookies. provider: plausible | ga4 | none. For ga4 set measurementId.

plans.name: AI
plans.for: Stores that want AI customer service

announcement.text: New: text your store on WhatsApp with Selo Copilot
